name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Study

requirements.blocker_text: Official documentation from a higher education institution listing the course of study, expected completion date, and student ID number.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to an accredited Azerbaijani higher education institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Equivalent enrollment verification from a secondary educational institution.

evidence_required.document: Enrollment confirmation (course, completion date, student ID)

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year, renewable while enrolled

sources.title: Azerbaijan State Migration Service -- grounds for temporary residence permit including study: enrollment verification for higher-education and secondary-school students

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Azerbaijan). No work-rights allowance (e.g. part-time work permission) or specific duration figure beyond the general 1-year temporary residence permit norm was found described for student status specifically -- modeled 'none' for work rights rather than assumed. pr_after_months (24) and citizenship_after_months (60) reuse the general figures from az_permanent_residence.json and az_naturalisation.json since no study-specific fast-track was found.
